header.title_en: Grade I · Urdu · FDE pattern practice paper
header.title_ur: جماعت اول · اردو · FDE pattern کا مشقی پرچہ
header.note_en: Written 60 + oral 40 = 100 marks. The oral part is taken by the teacher from the marking scheme.
header.note_ur: تحریری 60 + زبانی 40 = 100 نمبر۔ زبانی حصہ استاد مارکنگ اسکیم سے لیں گے۔

slots.prompt_rule: Ten three-option MCQs on letters, joining letters and simple words from the book (which letter starts a word, which word is a fruit, the right spelling), using at least six kinds of question across the ten (first letter, last letter, a word's category, odd one out, the right spelling, a word's picture, the missing letter) and at most two of any one kind. Joining letters is Q3's work: no item asks to join letters («+», «جوڑ کر»), and no word that Q3 uses appears here. Never print a rude or crude word anywhere, and never split or join a word into parts that form one (چھٹی is never چھ + ٹٹی). No two items share the same three options and the same key (v35 vi «خر_وش» and vii «گلاب» both offered ک، غ، گ and both keyed گ): vary the letters, or the kind of question, so one item never carries the answer of another. A letter-blank item's distractor letters never complete a real Urdu word either: «رو _ ی» with ٹ، ت، ط is wrong, because ت makes the real word «روتی» as well as «روٹی». Try every option in the blank and change the options until only the key makes a word.

slots.instruction_ur: حروف کو حروفِ تہجی کی ترتیب سے لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five items of three Urdu letters out of order. Answer: the ordered letters.

Five book words of two to four letters written apart, e.g. "ب + ط + خ". Answer: the joined word. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the joined word, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

slots.instruction_ur: تصویر دیکھ کر خانے میں سے نام لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five book objects, each as picture: {kind:"object", name} with name in English for the artist. Put all five Urdu words, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item only. Answer: the Urdu word. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

Five short book sentences, one blank each; the five answer words, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item. Every blank is one that only ONE box word fits: a sentence with only a possessive and a copula («میری ایک ___ ہے») fits any noun of its gender, so give each blank its own context (what the thing does, where it is, who has it) or keep two words of the same gender out of the box together. Never two blanks that two box words both complete: test every box word against every blank before you finish, and rewrite the sentence if a second word fits (v35 «بچہ اپنی کاپی ___ میں رکھتا ہے» took اسکول as well as بستہ; a place word fits any «___ میں» blank, so give that blank a detail only the keyed word has). The answer words are never reused as Q10's sentence words (a box word that Q5 prints, like جھولے, is not the subject of a Q10 picture). The sentence takes the box word exactly as it is printed: a blank right before a postposition (میں، پر، سے، کو، کا، کی، کے، تک) after an oblique modifier (اپنے) needs the oblique form, so never box «گھونسلا» for «اپنے ___ میں» (it needs «گھونسلے»); choose a sentence in which the printed box word fits as it stands. No answer or target word repeats another question's: the keyed word and the word asked about are never a keyed or asked word of any other question on this paper; a feminine or plural key that another question already keys is a repeat.

Five book nouns. Answer: the plural. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the given noun, one of it, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. The picture is the thing itself, which a child names with that word at a glance: never a room or a place, and never something a child would call by another word (a bed for کمرہ). The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

Five book nouns that have a common feminine pair. Answer: the feminine. Each item also carries picture: {kind:"object", name} of the given noun, in English for the artist; choose only words that can be drawn. A person or animal sets living: true in its picture and is drawn whole, head included, with its face (eyes, mouth) shown, and never a dress or a clothing item alone as a person. Prefer a word whose picture a six-year-old names at once (an animal) to one that needs a person recognised; when a person word is used, it is one family member or helper drawn whole. No answer or target word repeats another question's: the keyed word and the word asked about are never a keyed or asked word of any other question on this paper; a feminine or plural key that another question already keys is a repeat. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.
Five book words with a common opposite (بڑا، دن، اوپر). Answer: the opposite.

slots.instruction_ur: دیے گئے الفاظ سے جملے بنائیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five book words. Answer: one short model sentence; accept any correct sentence that uses the word. Every model sentence and every `accept` sentence contains the asked word exactly; an alternate that does not use the word is never listed (v37r4 «خوشی» listed a sentence with «خوش ہوا»). Write each accept entry as one clean sentence.

slots.instruction_ur: تصویر دیکھ کر ایک جملہ لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five scenes from book themes (a child at school, a family meal, a park) as picture: {kind:"scene", describe} in English for the artist. Answer: one model sentence that names the main thing in its own `describe` and what it is doing, using only what that `describe` shows (never a person, place or object it does not mention). Scheme: K 1 for a sentence about the picture, K 1 for correct joining and spelling. The model sentence and `accept` hold none of Q5's box words in any form (a box word handed to the picture sentence hands over the spelling it pays for): pick another name for the thing in the scene. The `describe` never names a person (no «named Banu»), shows exactly the number of people the key sentence speaks of (one child brushing teeth is one child), and the key uses لڑکا / لڑکی / بچہ, never a name. The picture is a plain black-outline drawing a child names at once: never a thing whose outline alone is unreadable (egg, ball, plate, cup, watch, bench, box). A small object placed in a scene is drawn large and in front.

lines_en: One mark per correct item unless the paper says otherwise.
Written marks only. Record the oral marks from the oral sheet, then add both on the class record.

before_exam.title_ur: استاد کے لیے: امتحان سے پہلے

Photocopy the question paper, all {n} pages, one per child.
You add: {duty} on the question paper, page {p} (book p. {b}).
Mark question by question across all copies, not copy by copy.

سوالیہ پرچے کے تمام {n} صفحات کی فوٹو کاپی کریں، ہر بچے کے لیے ایک۔
شامل کریں: {duty}، سوالیہ پرچہ صفحہ {p} (کتاب ص {b})۔
ہر سوال کو تمام کاپیوں میں ایک ساتھ جانچیں، ایک کاپی مکمل کر کے دوسری نہیں۔

oral.note_en: Take the oral part after the written paper, one child at a time. Read the script aloud as written.
oral.note_ur: زبانی حصہ تحریری پرچے کے بعد، ہر بچے سے الگ الگ لیں۔ اسکرپٹ لکھے ہوئے الفاظ میں پڑھ کر سنائیں۔

tasks.instruction_en: Point to each word. One mark per word read right.
tasks.instruction_ur: ہر لفظ پر انگلی رکھیں۔ ہر درست پڑھے گئے لفظ پر 1 نمبر۔
tasks.ask: Ten book words of two to four letters printed large, each a word the written paper prints nowhere in the written paper, not even as a longer or shorter form (never «تارے» when the paper has «ستارے»).

tasks.instruction_en: Ask the questions one by one. One mark per clear answer in a sentence.
tasks.instruction_ur: سوال ایک ایک کر کے پوچھیں۔ ہر واضح جملے والے جواب پر 1 نمبر۔
tasks.ask: Five short questions about the child's likes (food, colour, game, fruit, friend) with a model answer each.

rubric.en: Each answer in a clear sentence

tasks.instruction_en: Ask the child to tell you about their mother. Prompt with the questions if they stop.
tasks.instruction_ur: بچے سے کہیں کہ اپنی امی کے بارے میں بتائے۔ رک جائے تو سوالوں سے مدد کریں۔
tasks.ask: Three prompt questions (her name, what she does, what she cooks or likes). Each question asks exactly one thing and is never joined by «یا» or «اور» to a second question.

tasks.instruction_en: Read the book poem aloud once, then ask the questions.
tasks.instruction_ur: کتاب کی نظم ایک بار پڑھ کر سنائیں، پھر سوال پوچھیں۔
tasks.ask: Choose a book poem about nature, family, school, animals or play; never a hamd, naat, prayer or a poem that names God. The opening lines of that book poem (quote the book exactly) and five questions on it with answers. Each answer is a full sentence that names the word the question asks for, taken from the poem itself (a «who» question is answered with the name as the poem prints it), and never points at a line or a word position («نظم کے پہلے لفظ میں…»), never restates the question's words or opens «نظم میں». Every question names what it asks about; none asks which line a thing is in. No question or answer names God, a prayer or a religious form (حمد، نعت، دعا) in words the poem does not print, and no question prints a poem word that is another question's answer.

tasks.instruction_en: The child shows a drawing or object they made and talks about it.
tasks.instruction_ur: بچہ اپنی بنائی ہوئی تصویر یا چیز دکھا کر اس کے بارے میں بتائے۔
tasks.prep_en: A day or two before the oral part, have each child make the drawing or object for the project in class, so you see it is their own.
tasks.prep_ur: امتحان سے ایک دو دن پہلے ہر بچے سے کلاس میں پروجیکٹ کی تصویر یا چیز بنوائیں، تاکہ آپ دیکھ سکیں کہ کام بچے کا اپنا ہے۔
tasks.ask: One project idea from a book theme and three prompt questions about the drawing or object the child made. Name the lesson title once, inside a whole Urdu sentence (for example «ہمارے سبق «میں خاص ہوں» کی طرح…»), never after a colon and never with a stray word after the title.

rubric.en: On topic and shows two or more parts (4 for three or more, 3 for two, 2 for one, 1 for none clear)
rubric.ur: موضوع کے مطابق اور دو یا زیادہ حصے دکھائے (4 تین یا زیادہ، 3 دو، 2 ایک، 1 کوئی واضح نہیں)

rubric.en: Says what it is and how it was made
rubric.ur: بتاتا ہے کیا ہے اور کیسے بنایا
